title: Book 1 — Kindled Magic
description: The first year at the Magaambya. The cohort arrives as initiates, learns a branch, and leaves the year as attendants — still students, but no longer strangers to the school.

title: Session zero — the campaign frame
description: Before the first bell: the pitch, the six chosen characters, how branches and ranks work, what the Magaambya asks of the people it teaches, and why the six of them are a cohort rather than six strangers who happen to share a dorm.

title: Arrival and Welcome Walk
description: Their first day. Ot interviews them in a group and sets the aptitude tests that will decide whether they belong, the Spire Dorm tour introduces the people they will live beside, Xhokan explains the stipend and the free dining hall, and the first Perquisite day sends them off to the Rain-Scribes and a market full of chicks.

title: Greater connection to the bond
description: Asked what she wants from the school, Anya does not say a branch or a rank. She tells Ot she wants a deeper connection to the creature that accompanies her, and to the wild places it came from.

title: “I will provide”
description: The stipend arrives and leaves the same day, sent home in full. Cy’An does not consider this a sacrifice worth mentioning, which is exactly why it is worth noticing: to them, having money and not giving it away has never been an option.

title: The quiet investigator
description: Lithrei spends his first day watching. He does not volunteer, does not perform, and then asks the one question nobody else in the room had thought to ask — establishing, quietly, that his method is patience rather than speed.

title: A tomato for Ot and the astrologer's tent
description: A leshy who grew up in a ship’s kitchen arrives at a school of magic carrying a tomato for the teacher. Later, at the Kafesi market, she finds the astrologer’s tent, and for the first time in her life someone reads her charts as though they were worth reading.

title: Which obelisks are oldest?
description: Walking the campus for the first time, Taraan asks which of the obelisks are oldest. He also keeps looking up.

title: The transactional line, seen by Esi
description: Yggostrus tells Esi, plainly, that she has a use for him right now. It is not said cruelly — it is simply the only way he knows to describe a relationship — and Esi hears the shape of it.

title: Day 2 — Tempest-Sun
description: Day two takes them to the Tempest-Sun Mages, where pugwampis have taken over a storage barn. The cohort clears it without killing anything, learns from the records that Uduak was once expelled, and finds tunnels under both the barn and their own dorm. Anchor Root arrives on campus that same day.

title: The eidolon earns its keep
description: Anya climbs for mushrooms, breaks a jar she probably should not have broken, and helps drive the pugwampis down into the tunnels by being, simply, more alarming than they were. Her companion is useful for the first time in front of witnesses.

title: Ot's aside: “tests do not eat”
description: After the day’s tests, Ot stops Cy’An to say something small: that the tests do not eat, meaning the school’s judgement is not a mouth to feed. It is the first quiet crack in the idea that being useful is the same thing as being welcome.

title: The red-star and gateway omen
description: Lithrei researches the red-star and gateway omen he has been carrying, and finds enough to take it seriously.

title: Haibram's glider
description: Haibram lets her fly his glider, and she does. Afterward he promises her the formula. The sky she has been reading off charts her whole life becomes something she has actually touched.

title: Maps the tunnels with Erudite
description: Taraan and Erudite map the tunnels beneath the barn and the dorm. He reads them as a structure rather than a monument.

title: Friction with Anchor Root
description: Yggostrus and Anchor Root do not get along, and the friction is visible to everyone.

title: Day 3 — Cascade Bearers
description: Day three, with the Cascade Bearers. Mariama briefs them, hands them three oils and sends them into a fey-abeyance ritual that ends in a fight with Umbo, an outbreak of purple pox, and a ward the cohort helps cast.

title: MODU is named
description: Cy’An names the Mobile Oven Defense Unit, or MODU, and the room immediately understands what it is for.

title: The caterpillar gift
description: Lithrei buys a caterpillar as a gift, and the purchase quietly secures Anchor Root’s goodwill for the Rain-Scribes. The same day, Koride Ulawa is named to him on campus.

title: “Hope Umbo is feeling better”
description: After the fight with Umbo, Solanum says she hopes Umbo is feeling better. Nobody laughs, because she means it. She is capable of grieving a thing she just fought.

title: Reads the ritual structure
description: Watching the fey-abeyance ritual, Taraan reads it as a structure rather than a spell — the ward as architecture as much as magic. It is the archaeologist’s eye finding something to do in a school of mages.

title: A competence win, then an apology refused
description: Yggostrus leads the Nature work in the ritual and does it well, which matters more than it sounds. Then he apologizes to Anchor Root, and learns that the apology is accepted by her personally and refused on behalf of the group. Both things are true at once.

title: Day 4 — Emerald Boughs
description: Day four, with the Emerald Boughs: a full day of mail and errands that turns into its own small sandbox — Ignaci, Tzeniwe, letters addressed to gods, a dispute over a lamp, and a route that gets genuinely hard to run. At the picnic afterward, the anadi children shift shape in front of everyone.

title: The Bonding Meal
description: Cy’An’s Bonding Meal brings mother Caron and thirteen siblings onto the stage in front of the whole cohort. The wound they carry — that worth is usefulness, and family is an obligation you feed — is suddenly public, and nobody has to say a word about it.

title: A nat 20 on the anadi true form
description: Something in the way Taraan looks at Tzeniwe’s children lets them be seen as they actually are, and his roll lands clean. No fear, no flinch — just a tengu who thinks spiderlings are people, which is apparently rarer than it should be.

title: Day 5 — Uzunjati and the Introduction Ceremony
description: Day five, with the Uzunjati, alongside Okoro and Noxolo. The Introduction Ceremony is interrupted by Kurshkin and Havvix, and the interrogation that follows produces a name: the Stone Ghost. The cohort leaves the night at level 2.

title: The rolling pin is declared
description: Cy’An trades the glider plans to Solanum, delivers them, and declares the rolling pin their weapon. It is a joke that is also completely serious — a tool chosen for what it is actually for, by someone who has decided what they are actually for.

title: Pharasma-temple study begins
description: Lithrei begins studying Pharasma at the temple. Meanwhile Noxolo has a breakdown in front of him, and he treats it as an ordinary bad day rather than a revelation — which is, for both of them, the right call.

title: Dorm-wide stories and morals
description: Solanum trades battle-magic talk with Esi and tells stories to the whole dorm. The glider plans arrive from Cy’An. It is a night where she is simply one of the cohort, and that is the point of it.

title: Maps the founders' statues
description: Taraan maps the founders’ statues and, in doing so, delivers a moral to the whole dorm about companionship through change. He has been on campus five days and has already decided what the place is about.

title: Learns the eidolon shares damage
description: Yggostrus learns that his eidolon shares his damage — the cost of the bond runs both ways. Of everything he has been told about the creature, this is the first honest thing.

title: First Study block and the classmate favors
description: The first full Study block, and a night of classmate favors: Surprise, Rules Mastery, Lofty Leap, and the Lost Chicken. The Cricket Theft is settled not with a punishment but with a trade that establishes Koride’s breeding program. Implements are started and not finished.

title: Crams Cascade twice and earns a star
description: Cy’An crams Cascade twice in one night and comes away with a star. The branch reaches 1, and there is a banked success sitting at the cap — the reward for treating study the way they treat a kitchen.

title: Cascade reaches 1
description: Lithrei’s Cascade work reaches 1, and with it the branches are locked for five of the six heroes. The school now has an opinion about what each of them is.

title: Fails the Tempest-Sun Study
description: Solanum fails the Tempest-Sun Study and the branch stays at 0. She walks out of the night carrying a debt.

title: Uzunjati crit brings the branch to 2
description: Taraan crits the Uzunjati work and pushes the branch to 2 — the strongest Study result anyone at the table managed. The tengu who came for the sky turns out to be very good at the school part.

title: Rain-Scribes crit reaches 1
description: Yggostrus crits the Rain-Scribes work to reach 1, and in the process Koride’s breeding program opens a working relationship with the whole cohort. He wanted her attention; what he got was her attention on all of them.

title: Takulu's reading list — the stump library
description: Ot asks the cohort to recover five books from a tree-stump building that was being converted into a library before the project was abandoned. The stump is not empty: scrits have been chewing through it, and the fight eats most of the night, leaving half the rooms unsearched.

title: The stump library, finished
description: The back half of the stump: the stacked beds, the reading nook, the paper nest in the last room, and whatever else the cohort never reached. Then back to Ot with damaged books and a full accounting of what the building still holds.

title: Repairs a hinge Ot notices
description: Cy’An repairs a hinge Ot happens to notice. The craft is offered as help rather than proof, and for once nobody needs to be told what it means.

title: Reframes the Study failure as a research finding
description: Lithrei reframes his Study failure as a research finding. A library held together by silverfish is exactly the kind of place an unfinished student would haunt, and he knows it.

title: The reading nook
description: Solanum finds a reading nook in the stump library and turns her failed Study into a research project — she was reading, not failing. She also picks up a Tempest-Sun success, clearing the debt that had been following her.

title: Bell garland and a structural read
description: Taraan hangs a bell garland and reads the building’s structure. Then, in the Heron Archives, he mentions Ird. A teacher receives the name with polite institutional silence and changes the subject, and that is the whole answer he gets.

title: Koride's first warm contact
description: Koride Ulawa takes a real interest in Yggostrus — not in what he can do for her, but in what he is. One exchange is enough.

title: Monochrome Murmurs
description: Monochrome Murmurs: Zuma, the Tattoo Whispers ritual, linked minds inside the Elephant Museum office. The cohort shares thoughts for an afternoon and learns more about each other than any of them asked to.

title: Zuma's debut
description: Zuma debuts and tells Lithrei the school is hiding something. She is useful, exhausting, and occasionally right, and she is a mirror for his method rather than his mystery — which is precisely why she gets under his skin.

title: A truthful but useless augury
description: Yggostrus consults an augury scroll and it answers him honestly. It tells him something true that he cannot possibly use, and that is the whole scene.

title: Study block and free time
description: A study block and an evening of free time. Ahassunu joins the Heron Archives and Lesedi opens the planetarium dome, and the cohort is given the rare luxury of a night with no crisis attached.

title: The empty shift
description: Lumusi covers the kitchen and sends Cy’An out for the evening. The question the scene actually asks is not whether they can relax but whether they can stay out once they are gone.

title: Ahassunu's first slip
description: Ahassunu cannot find a file she is certain exists. She does not raise her voice or call it strange — she simply fails to find it — and Lithrei is left to notice what nobody else in the room does.

title: Lesedi's debut
description: Lesedi debuts in the planetarium and takes Solanum’s chart seriously as research rather than a student’s hobby. She also corrects one planar assumption flatly, with a warning attached: that mistake kills people.

title: The Ird-taboo aside, pressed
description: In the Heron Archives, Taraan asks about Ird a second time, more directly than the first. The answer is the same polite institutional silence, and the conversation moves on without him. Nothing follows it, and that is the whole reply.

title: Bug Problems
description: Koride’s specimen list sends the cohort to the Leshy Gardens, the Speaker’s Stage canal, and the kitchen. Anchor Root has strong opinions about centipedes, which turns out to be relevant when a centipede swarm arrives in the kitchen.

title: Mafika light — body versus dome
description: Mafika’s mecha-leshy bout asks Solanum to use her body while her mind is still up in the rafters. She is present in the fight and elsewhere entirely, and the gap between the two is the scene.

title: Koride treats him as a specimen
description: Koride treats Yggostrus as one more specimen among her insects, and the flattery he has been living on curdles in real time. Cy’An shares the branch and sees the whole thing happen.

title: Starday Tournament
description: The Starday Tournament: Mafika’s mecha-leshy bouts across three rounds, with a crowd that has come specifically to watch. The cohort’s first taste of a public that is not a classroom.

title: Public glory, wrong court
description: Yggostrus can win, and does, and still finds that the crowd is not a court. Applause turns out to be a very different thing from recognition.

title: Second Study block and free time
description: A second Study block and an evening of free time, with the classmate favors still unfinished. Branch levels rise, the implements finally get completed, and the preparation phase closes.

title: A token unearned by labour
description: Cy’An is given a token they did not earn by labor. Deflecting it early is correct; the scene is not supposed to end with them accepting it gracefully.

title: First Masking
description: First Masking, in the Tireless Hall: wooden spirit masks, initiates becoming attendants, and a giant insect attack that arrives before the ceremony is quite finished. The cohort leaves at level 3, wearing faces that are not theirs.

title: A person in a mask, not just a hearth-tool
description: Cy’An wears a mask and is asked, without anyone saying it out loud, whose face you wear when the face is the job. For someone who has been primarily a provider, being offered a different face is not obviously a gift.

title: Whose face, for a breath?
description: Two people in one skin are offered a mask, and the question turns out to be whose face it is for a breath. Lithrei has been carrying a passenger all along; the ritual asks which of them is being inducted.

title: Growth is the honest answer
description: Whose face, if you are a fruit? The honest answer, and the one the mask accepts, is growth.

title: Soralyon's face
description: The mask asks Taraan which self he named himself after, and the answer is Soralyon — a patron he did not know was watching.

title: A mask over a cursed identity
description: Yggostrus is given a mask over an identity that is already a curse, and the ritual simply formalizes what he has been doing for years. Nobody at the table finds this comforting.

title: Assignment from Ot and Koride
description: Ot and Koride give the cohort their assignment: a map inherited from Koride’s withdrawn students, leading to a staging room, a wet hollow, a mushroom of unreasonable size, and a set of centipede traps that someone built on purpose.

title: Izem Mezitani debuts
description: Izem Mezitani debuts, consulting on tunnel masonry, and Taraan has found the teacher he actually wants. Erudite maps the dig while Izem talks about never defiling a find.

title: Deep caverns
description: The cohort goes deeper: gnagrifs, an irritated hive, a war room, a pantry, Binji’s bedroll, and a training ground, all of it belonging to Urbel and a functioning gremlin society that nobody expected to find under the campus.

title: Stone Ghost
description: Stone Ghost: Uduak’s room, the confrontation, and level 4 at the end of it. The tunnels were never the mystery — they were the route.

title: The duet
description: The duet: Taraan speaks for institutional duty, Lithrei for lived possession, and neither of them is wrong. Play it as an argument between friends.

title: Gremlins as people
description: Faced with a gremlin society, Solanum is the one who does not want the hive killed. Her grief for Umbo has already told her that the things you fight are still things.

title: The institutional-duty voice
description: Taraan takes the institutional-duty side of the duet — Soralyon says preserve the record, and the record is the point. The one thing to avoid is merging the passenger with Uduak; they are not the same death.

title: Aftermath and griffon attack
description: Aftermath. The anadi seekers arrive in hybrid form, a griffon attacks, and Book 1 closes on a campus that has been quietly opened from underneath.

title: Book 2 — Spoken on the Song Wind
description: The second year. The cohort returns as attendants, spends the year in the city as much as the classroom, and ends it as lore-speakers with teaching duties waiting.

title: Janatimo's audience
description: Janatimo debriefs Book 1 and puts four debate questions to the cohort — one realistic, one outlandish — grading them on Impression Points. The prize is the crown of the companion, and every PC is expected to answer at least once.

title: Omen logic in a debate hall
description: Solanum answers the griffon questions with omen logic, in a debate hall, in front of a teacher who is genuinely trying to grade her. The room is politely baffled and she is entirely sincere.

title: Investigation A, part 1
description: The first investigation begins: find Goss, Mazta, and Savana, either through Tzeniwe or through asking around the city. The Hababe Building is the first stop, and there is a terra-cotta soldier standing where a guard should be.

title: Investigation A, part 2
description: The Hababe Building proper: supply room, serpent ward, Coil spies, talisman room, wood golem, and alchemy storage, ending at a passwall into Koride’s own laboratory. The cohort reaches level 5 in a building that keeps being larger than it looked.

title: First Ird echo
description: Taraan finds a fragment bearing soul-trade iconography and a seven-fingered handprint. Never a map, never a name — just enough to be certain that this is not the first time he has seen the shape.

title: The egg rhyme
description: Someone is studying Koride’s secret, and Yggostrus recognizes the specimen jars because she showed them to him. Being trusted, it turns out, is how you end up implicated.

title: Investigation B — Oba Eze's Wondrous Creatures
description: Investigation B takes the cohort to Oba Eze’s Wondrous Creatures: an animal lot, a tiger cage, elephant-bird cages, griffon cages, a basilisk, and the mpeshi. Froglegs is implicated, and the animal trade stops being an abstraction.

title: Cannot look away
description: At Oba Eze’s, Solanum is not the one who solves anything — she is the one who cannot look away from the cages.

title: Follow-up, semester, and Study
description: A follow-up session, a semester boundary, and a Study block. Ahassunu lets slip a name from a student file that has been scrubbed, and the lead goes cold almost immediately.

title: The scrubbed file
description: A name pulled from a student record that someone has edited, with Noxolo present to hear it. The removal is old. Somebody at this school erased a person and did it long enough ago that nobody remembers doing it.

title: Asymmetric care
description: Another PC does something for Yggostrus that he cannot possibly repay. His research stalls not because he lacks the skill but because he cannot name who would hold the other half of him.

title: Conversant promotion
description: The Conversant promotion: Janatimo’s letter, the ceremony, and a speech from each PC on the best use of magic in the world. Chizire comes to watch, because of course he does.

title: Suspicious Alchemy
description: Xhokan brings the cohort a problem: tainted powder, a supplier named Bamidele, and a chase through the market before the afternoon is out.

title: Flooded Workshop
description: Amaechi’s pottery workshop has flooded. The cohort shores up the structure and restores the canal, which is a simpler task than the conversation that follows it.

title: A need that isn't material
description: The potter’s problem is not soup. Cy’An arrives with a wheelbarrow of food and is warmly, gently refused, and the refusal is the lesson: some needs cannot be met by providing.

title: Ghost Stories and Reth's Shack
description: Ghost Stories and Reth’s Shack: Mashkudu, Kiru, Loakan, Reth, and a crew of lizardfolk with a labour dispute that everyone keeps calling a haunting.

title: Tell a Tale and Tokku's Home
description: Tell a Tale and Tokku’s Home: a poltergeist, Kalembi’s history, and the return of a figurine that should probably never have been taken.

title: The home letter reframed
description: A letter from home that changes its mind three times. First thanks for the coin, then that they miss Cy’An, then that they are proud the family member left — and the third one is the one that lands.

title: Second Ird echo
description: Kalembi’s personal archive in Tokku’s home holds a matching soul-trade motif. Okoro or Noxolo can guest so that the discovery is a friendship scene rather than a solo lore dump.

title: Carnivorous Gardens
description: Carnivorous Gardens: plants that eat, oozes that do not care, and a grate that has been destroyed by something large enough to be a problem.

title: Fiery Debt and Fire-Pot's Forge
description: Fiery Debt and Fire-Pot’s Forge: minotaur shops, a boulder trap, striding fires, and Ubanu. The cohort reaches level 6.

title: Finding Froglegs
description: Finding Froglegs: the Thieves’ Swamp, grippli skirmishers, Old Thrasher, and a hut at the end of it. The griffon chain closes and the cohort reaches level 7, with the animal-trafficking thread finally finished.

title: The flooded mansion briefing
description: Suspicion about Asanda crystallizes, Janatimo briefs the cohort on the flooded mansion, and they are handed scrolls of clairvoyance, freedom of movement, and restoration — the school’s way of saying it expects this to go badly.

title: Manor lower floors
description: The manor’s lower floors: entrance hall, greeting room, the main-hall ward, dining room, kitchen, and a grodair in a house that is supposed to be underwater.

title: Ballroom and Asanda's chamber
description: The ballroom, with Gbahali and musicians still playing, a guest room, and Asanda’s own chamber. The mansion has been maintained, which is its own kind of horror.

title: Salathiss
description: Salathiss, in the entertainment suite, and the work of liberating the real Asanda from whatever has been wearing her.

title: A shapeshifter impersonating authority
description: A shapeshifter impersonating authority, faced by the party’s best face, whose own identity is a forgery. Play it without comment and let the table notice.

title: Graduation at the name obelisk
description: Graduation at the name obelisk, with lore-speaker speeches all around, and Janatimo asking the cohort to stay on as teachers. Level 8 — the end of being students in any sense the school recognizes.

title: The best use of magic in the world
description: Cy’An speaks on the best use of magic in the world while standing next to the people who fed them. It is the first time the question has been asked of them in public, and they answer it in public.

title: Book 3 — Hurricane's Howl
description: The third year. The cohort are teachers now, with offices, stipends, students of their own, and considerably less protection than they had as students.

title: Teacher life
description: Teacher life: offices in the Heron Archives, stipends, the honorific nobody quite gets used to, a student cohort of their own, and Esi now a colleague rather than a dorm neighbour.

title: Teaching philosophy, and the Izem dig-ethics bond
description: Taraan states his teaching philosophy aloud — never defile the find — and the Izem dig-ethics bond matures. It is a fine principle to hold at a school that defiles its own records.

title: Students who want to be him
description: Yggostrus gets students who want to be him rather than learn from him. The mirror is uncomfortable, and it does not stop being uncomfortable.

title: An Evening Reminiscing
description: An Evening Reminiscing: Mariama and Ignaci’s glyph hunt, a Sparring and Study session with Onyiji, and a runaway experiment that ends the night. The Spire Dorm cohort is together again, as peers, for the only time in the book.

title: The Lifelong Student
description: The Lifelong Student: Jumimo refuses to graduate, and the cohort spends the rest of the session on student problems of the week, which are exactly as small and as serious as they sound.

title: Let a student fail safely
description: Cy’An lets a student fail safely: hand over a hint, do not finish the dish. Success is the student feeding someone else using Cy’An’s method rather than Cy’An’s hands.

title: Stabilize a stressed student without a cage
description: Lithrei stabilizes a stressed student without putting them in a cage. Noxolo names the containment logic out loud, having heard him describe the monastery, and the moment lands because she is not guessing.

title: I'boko's Disappearance
description: I’boko disappears, and her classmates hid it. Oyamba reframes the whole thing as sanctioned research at Bloodsalt, and the cohort reaches level 9 while still deciding whether they believe him.

title: Travel to Terwa Lake
description: The road to Terwa Lake, with Mocking Cries and Shaking Bones along the way and karnias in the water. Field-teaching under pressure, with students in tow.

title: Ruins of Bloodsalt
description: Ruins of Bloodsalt: the Mudwringer camp, Thiarvo the Quick, a collapsed tower, bog mummies, and a mural wall that somebody painted very deliberately.

title: Third Ird echo
description: A Dragon-Speaker ruin with soul-trade iconography, and Izem present for it. Taraan is asked to cheer the fall of tyrants and still be furious at the idea of levelling a city, and both reactions are his.

title: Shoreline and Ixamè
description: The shoreline and the hatchery, and then Ixamè: an undead air dragon, and the ritual to remind it of what it was.

title: Reads the omen wrong first
description: Solanum reads the omen wrong. An air dragon that cannot fly is a lesson in what omens are not — they are not omnipotent, and the people who trust them most are the ones who get surprised.

title: Practical Research in Bloodsalt
description: Practical Research in Bloodsalt, and downtime rebuilding Kiutu. Branch progress comes from field discovery rather than teaching, and it is worth saying so at the table.

title: Aerial predator and the undead knight
description: A kongamato in the air, the river crossing, and Bharlen Sajor — an undead knight with business of his own.

title: Terwa Lords
description: The Terwa Lords: iruxi allies, Ssaraku Akai, Giri, and a set of lizardfolk scouts. Level 10, and Yggostrus’s Diplomacy face gets a genuine win.

title: Baobab Orchard
description: The Baobab Orchard: boggard hunters, a prisoner shed, Youuti, and Mobogo. Abducted villagers are freed, which is the emotional payload the chapter has been promising.

title: Food as the first thing done
description: For people who have been caged, food is the first thing done and the first thing offered. Cy’An does not make a speech about it.

title: Into the Sodden Lands
description: Into the Sodden Lands: stragglers on the road, and the approach to a prison that the cohort can now see from a distance.

title: Prison of the Vacant Eye — entering
description: Entering the Prison of the Vacant Eye: main entrance, mess hall, kitchen, bunk rooms, and squalid cells. The prisoners are the reason to be here, not the loot.

title: Prison interior and Tir
description: The prison proper: the warden’s room, ritual room, Bashantu, the armory, the frog pen, Halbrux Far-Sight, sleeping slabs, an excavation, and Tir the gogiteth. Level 11 at the bottom of it.

title: Taking the jail
description: The jail is taken, and the prisoners reveal what the cohort came for: I’boko and her father were taken to Jula and handed to Ajbal Kimon. Practical Research follows from the discovery itself.

title: The unattended dead
description: Prisoners as the point rather than the loot. Lithrei has spent years with a spirit that would not rest; here the dead are simply unattended, and that is enough.

title: Jula's plight
description: Jula’s plight: gates, shakedowns, Father Heveril, and the work of rallying a town that has learned not to expect help.

title: Alehouse headquarters and smuggler caves
description: The alehouse headquarters and the smuggler caves behind it: a secret trapdoor, traps, plunder stores, a prison wall, and spies. The longest dungeon sequence in the book.

title: Mentors a “small life” student
description: Solanum mentors a “small life” student — Archibald inverted — and admits out loud that the Sodden sky is hard to read. Being honest about what she cannot do is the point of the beat.

title: Ajbal Kimon
description: Ajbal Kimon, in the sacrifice cave, and the end of the cult’s grip on Jula. Level 12, and the cohort returns to the Magaambya as famous teachers.

title: Book 4 — Secrets of the Temple-City
description: The fourth year: diplomacy and sovereignty. The cohort leaves the school as representatives of it and discovers how little a reputation is worth in a room full of rulers.

title: Oyamba's briefing
description: Oyamba briefs the cohort in the Archhorn Library and sets the terms of the Mzali mission: deal with evil, but no assassination and no coup. The delegation includes Ahassunu, Izem Mezitani, and Koride Ulawa.

title: Systems that erase people
description: In Mzali, the provider who insists on fixing everything gets used. It is access rather than betrayal — Cy’An is respected, and it still costs them, which is the harder version of the lesson.

title: Izem on the Mzali delegation
description: Izem is on the Mzali delegation, and Taraan watches a colleague seek atonement with a regime that traffics in death. Do not explain the parallel; let him draw it.

title: Koride travels with the delegation
description: Koride travels with the delegation, which means weeks of proximity. She is at her most sympathetic here and also her most reckless, and Yggostrus gets to see both.

title: Travel to Mzali
description: Travel to Mzali: a welcome gift that is also a warning, jackal guards at every gate, and the necropolis on the horizon.

title: Influence I
description: Influence I: Nkiruka, Walkena’s speaker, and M’Bele Numbe. The first of the favour-grind rounds, and the first chance for Yggostrus’s court language to meet an actual court.

title: Influence II
description: Influence II: Sihar, Thembu Sufu, and Wekesa. Izem is here seeking atonement, and Taraan can either help or simply witness it.

title: Influence III
description: Influence III: Worknesh of the military and Zubari, head of the Council and highest priest. The last and heaviest of the Mzali rounds.

title: Mzali's death-politics as a mirror
description: Mzali’s death-politics hold up a mirror to a school that buries its failures. Zubari is the one who says it plainly, without any interest in being gentle.

title: Worknesh's Challenge and the audience with Walkena
description: Worknesh’s Challenge, One Last Request, and an audience with Walkena. Level 13, and every PC gets to steelman one of Walkena’s arguments before rejecting it.

title: Shrine of the Eclipse
description: Lower floors of the Shrine of the Eclipse: prayer chambers, sanctuary, a secret room, the sun shrine, gardens, a kitchen, and the sanctum. A temple to a sun goddess of eclipses, laid out like a house.

title: The eclipse spike
description: The eclipse spike: every chart Solanum has ever drawn gets a physical answer at once. Play it as awe rather than exposition — no mechanics, no explanation, just the sky doing what she said it would.

title: Freeing Dajermube
description: The ritual chamber, Dajermube’s chamber, and the freeing of a trapped prisoner-goddess, which yields the Osibu secret. Level 14.

title: Partial identity — role, era, manner of death
description: Partial identity: role, era, and manner of death, offered by a trapped prisoner-goddess. The passenger recognizes the shape and not the face, and that is as far as it goes for now.

title: Screaming Jungle
description: The Screaming Jungle: a doprillu attack, emotion seekers, and kilia mwibos. Solanum’s unease gets exercised.

title: First contact with Osibu
description: First contact with Osibu. Gold defenders meet the cohort at the edge of the city, and the city’s guardians challenge them before anyone is allowed inside.

title: Infrastructure as care
description: Infrastructure as care: one person should not be the whole kitchen. Cy’An helps the Osibu build a system and then steps back from it, which is the hardest thing they have been asked to do.

title: Life in Osibu and Dimari-Diji
description: Life in Osibu, and Dimari-Diji — an ancient arboreal guardian with something to say to more than one of them. Practical Research in Osibu follows.

title: “Two people in one skin”
description: Dimari-Diji observes, in one sentence, that Lithrei is two people in one skin, and then does not elaborate. One sentence, no explanation.

title: “A debt of silence”
description: Dimari-Diji senses a debt of silence in Taraan’s magic and declines to explain it. It arrives as a courtesy rather than a revelation.

title: The siege begins
description: The siege begins: Walkena’s forces, and the attack of the sun-spires on a city that has never been taken.

title: Organizes the defence as a working system
description: Cy’An organizes the defence of Osibu as a working system rather than a series of personal heroics, and the city holds because of it.

title: Piercing the wall
description: Piercing the wall: breaking the golden blade, and Worknesh arriving to make the fight worse before it gets better.

title: Walkena's fury
description: Walkena’s fury, with Dimari-Diji’s ritual countdown made visible for the first time. The party can now see how much time they do not have.

title: Avatar of Walkena
description: The Avatar of Walkena, and Osibu saved. Level 15, and Dimari-Diji tells the cohort that Jatembe is on Akiton.

title: “I've seen this sky before”
description: The reveal lands: years of journal omens finally click, and Solanum is the one who says she has seen this sky before. She has never been off Golarion.

title: Book 5 — Doorway to the Red Star
description: The fifth year: cosmic succession. The cohort leaves Golarion, and the red star they have been reading about since session two becomes weather.

title: Semester downtime and Preparatory Research
description: A semester of downtime in two-week blocks, and Preparatory Research into the Iobane, the King of Biting Ants, and the geography of Akiton. The alignment window gets identified, which turns a legend into a deadline.

title: Her charts predict the alignment
description: Solanum’s charts predict the alignment, and Lesedi confirms it. She is a colleague now rather than a student, and the thing she has been doing alone her whole life is suddenly infrastructure.

title: Events 1–2 — A Diplomatic Dilemma, Disruptive Admirers
description: Events one and two: A Diplomatic Dilemma with Raido-Kan, and Disruptive Admirers who turn out to be Izem’s pixies.

title: Izem invites Taraan
description: The archaeologist with wings invites the tengu who wants them on the expedition, independently, of his own accord.

title: Events 3–4 — An Impromptu Field Trip, Assistant Summoner Duty
description: Events three and four: An Impromptu Field Trip that runs into the Grootslang, and Assistant Summoner Duty with Lesedi.

title: Lesedi's aside
description: Lesedi delivers it as a throwaway by someone who genuinely means it: space travel would have been superior to the Red Planet had Lirgen’s technology survived.

title: Events 5–6 — Nantambu Noodles, Pollen for Paintings
description: Events five and six: Nantambu Noodles at Mafika’s ramen cart, and Pollen for Paintings with Nhyira.

title: Event 7 — First Flight
description: Event seven: First Flight, aboard Tahenkot’s airship, with Haibram the only remaining crew and the Doorway at the end of the journey.

title: Taraan crews; he does not pilot
description: Taraan crews the airship and does not pilot it. The altitude hunger from session one is a job now, and the tengu who named himself Skyseeker is finally getting paid for it.

title: Events 8–9 — Pranksters in Peril, Runelord Rainbow
description: Events eight and nine: Pranksters in Peril, and Runelord Rainbow, where Zuma’s ritual earns its keep.

title: The Iobane and Mpondo
description: The Iobane and Mpondo: peace talks, Practical Research at the Doorway, and Mpondo’s Request. Level 16.

title: The empty doorway
description: The empty doorway: the Iobane describe a portal as a door with nothing behind it until it opens. Say nothing and let Solanum sit with it.

title: The unbinding ordeal begins
description: The unbinding ordeal begins with an empty doorway and an offer of help. The only question that matters is whether he takes it, and from whom.

title: Revelations of Betrayal
description: Revelations of Betrayal, through the Cathedral of Nothingness: entryway, choir, crypt, sanctum, Taon, Sparkeater, and Dwandek. Soul cages, and a cult that traded selves for power.

title: Passage through the Doorway
description: Passage through the Doorway into Akiton’s thin air and light gravity. The red star stops being a point of light and becomes a sky you stand under.

title: Akiton wonder
description: Akiton wonder: everything Solanum read off a chart as a child is now weather she is standing in. Play it slowly — no mechanics, no explanation.

title: Hall of Reason
description: The Hall of Reason: the Chamber of Meditation, the main passageway, the Fourteen Curiosities, and aeons. Contemplatives are scholar-creatures, and both Yggostrus’s Diplomacy and Taraan’s lore matter here.

title: Gardens of Enlightenment
description: The Gardens of Enlightenment, the Ravager of Tindalos, and peace returning. Level 17, and a change of register before Seldo.

title: Vocation under pressure
description: Vocation under pressure: Life Link on Akiton, where the passenger is a liability in a place with no graves. One glance at Jatembe at most, and then redirect.

title: The fork resolves
description: The fork resolves. Soul cages, and a cult that traded selves for power: Path A is magnificent and hollow, Path B still needs allies. Do not punish Path A — let it be lonely instead.

title: Road to Seldo
description: The road to Seldo, the Great Gritcrawler, and the work of finding answers and researching an enemy that has been winning for a very long time.

title: Meeting Skartitch
description: Meeting Skartitch at Tan-Takneh’s camp: Skartitch’s Cantina, sand racers, and a lesson in boarding an insect ship in motion.

title: The race I
description: The first leg of the race: Red Desert, Scarlet Rift, the Gluttonworm, and Ikesti territory. Solanum’s best physical showcase, and pure chase mechanics.

title: The race II
description: The second leg: Formian hivelands, racing results, and the moment the tables turn. Decide in advance what losing a leg of the race actually costs.

title: Boarding the Mandibles of Fate
description: Boarding the Mandibles of Fate: quarterdeck, main deck, forecastle, laboratory, rejuvenation centre, brig, hatchery, and bridge. An insect sky, and a hive ship.

title: One line about the name
description: One line about the name, and nothing more: an insect sky, a hive ship, a star that has been overhead her whole life and is now under her feet.

title: Free Jatembe
description: Free Jatembe, and the King of Biting Ants. Level 18, Jatembe’s aid offered without ceremony, and then the return.

title: Dust or a frond for Archibald
description: Solanum bottles dust or a frond for Archibald. One sentence, no scene — the kitchen is still the place she sends things home to.

title: The conversation
description: The conversation. A quiet moment after the King falls, with Jatembe present and deflecting praise, and Taraan pressing the destruction story. “As your power grows, you may be allowed to remember. But you will still not be allowed to tell.”

title: Return to Golarion
description: Return to Golarion, and the King’s contingency waiting for them.

title: Empty hands
description: Empty hands: the one beat on the red planet where nothing can be fixed, and Cy’An has to sit in it rather than cook their way out.

title: “My cohort”
description: Yggostrus says “my cohort” in the language of patronage. He would rather die than use the word friends.

title: Book 6 — Shadows of the Ancients
description: The sixth year: the campaign’s endgame. The cohort becomes Magic Warriors, and everything the school has been growing underneath them finally comes up.

title: Return celebration and Magic Warrior renaming
description: The return celebration and the Magic Warrior renaming ceremony at the name obelisk. Jatembe names them; bead bracelets are given; the world forgets their old names. Koride and the original cohort are not there, and the wrongness sits in the room unacknowledged.

title: Renamed as horizon or growth
description: Every PC names a title, and Solanum’s lands as horizon or growth — the same answer the First Masking gave her, now made permanent.

title: A shared secret
description: A shared secret between two people who know what it costs to set a name aside. Optional further remembering across the book; still no telling.

title: Luncheon influence
description: Luncheon influence across four rounds: Asanda, Father Heveril, Mpondo, and Umanja-jinga. A parade of everyone the cohort has helped, arriving at the moment they are least sure it counted.

title: The Barb
description: Cohort members are acting oddly and running Koride’s insect research. The Barb takes the cohort through the venom pool, Ignaci’s room, the research library, and void portals — all while familiar faces are quietly hollowed out.

title: The Unshadowed cohort
description: The Unshadowed cohort: hollowed Okoro, Mariama, Anchor Root, and Haibram. His friends are the ones who will not rest.

title: Protea Pavilion lower
description: The Protea Pavilion lower floors: lignified guardians, the Dolorous Tree, a courtyard, Ta’apundo, storage, and a garden portal. The pavilion has been relocated into overgrown hedges.

title: Unshadowed Koride
description: Unshadowed Koride: the true Koride fighting from inside a hollowed shell. The egg fractures and shrinks the party. Level 19.

title: He speaks first
description: Yggostrus speaks first in the Koride parley, and five books of investment cash out in a single conversation with the hollowed woman who once found him fascinating.

title: The Endless Table — cottage and upper camp
description: The Endless Table: a cottage and an upper camp, ant patrols, Adanyini the kitten, clockwork hazards, the Drum, and the Ash Desert. A deliberate fable register after five books of escalation.

title: Red ant court
description: The red ant court: a viewing box, a shadow crowd, the Dancing Regent, and red commander ants, then the Gourd Fortress, an acid lake, and a Tarn Linnorm. The red queen wants to marry the returning King; play it absurd and sad.

title: Four shadow fragments and the Vesicant Egg
description: Four shadow fragments recovered, Hlakana the norn, and the claiming of the Vesicant Egg. The party is restored to normal size and reaches level 20.

title: Rest, integrate, or witness
description: Rest, integrate, or witness — decided during the shadow-fragment work. There is no correct answer, and the table gets to make it.

title: The larva erupts
description: The larva erupts and the campaign goes into disaster mode: Tahenkot’s class stranded on the acid island, the Osirian diplomats needing shelter, Xhokan’s Powderpile, rooftops, and a tower coming down.

title: Build the system
description: Cy’An builds the system rather than carrying it: a soup line, runners, triage, and the discipline not to personally spoon-feed thousands of people.

title: The Circle ritual
description: The Circle ritual: Koride contrite, Jatembe leading, allies gathering at the Ten Magic Warrior statues, and waves of wereants and swarms while the cohort guards the ritual itself.

title: Noxolo at the statues
description: Noxolo coordinates at the Magic Warrior statues, and years of a quiet friendship become literal logistics at the exact moment the school needs them.

title: Mind of the King
description: The Mind of the King in three aspects, Slana hatching as the Vesicant Guardian, and an epilogue. The campaign ends where it began: at a school that keeps asking what you teach now.

title: Rest, guest as well as host
description: Cy’An’s renaming includes rest, guest as well as host. The coda is that the family is glad to see them, not only the beads.

title: The Whispering Word docks
description: The Whispering Word docks, and Archibald meets Magaambya-Solanum. The ship’s kitchen and the school finally in the same room, and no second cosmos plot required.

title: Renamed as keeper, not owner
description: Yggostrus is renamed as keeper rather than owner — the Magic Warrior epilogue, and the last word on the sealed dragon.
